A little clarity

Good questions.
Clear answers.

A few things you might want to know before we get started.

Do you offer 24-hour plumbing?

Yes. DT Plumbing offers 24-hour plumbing support. Availability and the next steps for your specific problem need to be confirmed directly with Tristan. See our .

Can I get a quote before work starts?

Share a description of your job, your area and any useful details. Tristan can discuss the scope and what is needed to prepare a quote. Prepare your enquiry below.

Can you help with a renovation?

Renovations are part of DT Plumbing’s service offering, alongside plumbing and maintenance. Discuss your ideas with Tristan to confirm the work your project needs.

Do you take on small handyman jobs?

Yes. Handyman services cover enquiries about smaller repairs and practical property improvements. Put together your to-do list so you can discuss what can be arranged.
